source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Judge whether a human-made or managed ecosystem practice supports ecosystem health by checking its effects on pollution, biodiversity, soil health, and long-term farming.
node_labels: Living systems: organisms, health and ecosystems

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The decision still holds even if we ignore this condition: Fish ponds, farms, and parks are human-made ecosystems created to meet human needs.

intelligence.enrichment: Human-made ecosystems and farming practices can meet human needs, but they support ecosystem health only when they are well designed and managed with environment-friendly practices. Design and management choices affect pollution, biodiversity, soil nourishment, crop production, and long-term sustainability. The learner correctly applies this rule: Human-made ecosystems and farming practices can meet human needs, but they support ecosystem health only when they are well designed and managed with environment-friendly practices. If a practice increases crop production or is human-made, it automatically supports ecosystem health.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Ecosystems and habitats.
